title: Timers._unrefActive has been removed
summary: Node.js removed timers._unrefActive (DEP0127: runtime deprecation since v11.14.0, end-of-life since v24.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of timers._unrefActive with timeout.refresh(), or timeout.unref().

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
